name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II (2022)

locations.note: Price, Gaz and Laswell chase one of Hassan's couriers through Amsterdam and learn that Hassan is hiding with the Las Almas cartel in Mexico.
Task Force 141 and Alejandro's Los Vaqueros hunt Hassan through the cartel city of Las Almas; after Shadow Company's betrayal Ghost and Soap escape through it and the team retakes the Vaqueros' base.
Data from Hassan's phone leads Price, Gaz and Laswell to Cape Vilan, where they find the Las Almas cartel holding Russian-made GPS units for the missiles.
Dark Water: Task Force 141, Shadow Company and Alejandro raid an oil rig in the Gulf of Mexico to stop a missile launch, and Graves turns on them afterwards.
Task Force 141 stops Hassan's missile in Chicago before it reaches the Pentagon, and Ghost kills him.
Al Mazrah, capital of the invented United Republic of Adal, is the campaign's main theatre and the Warzone map.

routes.name: Task Force 141
routes.note: From a missile strike in Al Mazrah and a courier chase through Amsterdam into the cartel's Las Almas, out to Cape Vilan, back to Mexico and the oil rig in the Gulf, ending with Hassan's missile stopped over Chicago.
